tasks.title: Honey bees
tasks.text: Honey bees live in large groups called colonies, and every bee in a colony has its own job. Young bees clean the hive and feed the babies, while older ones fly out to collect nectar from flowers. A single bee may visit hundreds of flowers in one day. When it finds a good place, it returns to the hive and performs a special dance to tell the others where to go. Bees are important not only for honey: they also help plants to produce fruit and seeds. Without them, many of the fruits and vegetables that we like would become rare and expensive.
